abstract: Autonomous precision milling of biological structures is challenged by incomplete knowledge of target geometry, local material thickness, and critical internal boundaries. Subject-specific preoperative models can address geometric and thickness variations, but static models cannot determine boundary status encountered during execution, while repeated target-specific imaging limits scalability. This article presents an uncertainty-aware autonomous milling framework that assigns complementary roles to generic anatomical priors and active boundary perception. A generic anatomical prior provides conservative global guidance and is transformed through semantic-guided registration and hybrid vision-force calibration into robot-executable guidance for individual targets. As milling approaches uncertain boundaries, the robot actively probes the remaining structure and uses relative stiffness changes to estimate boundary status and structural detachability. A state-adaptive controller governs transitions between active perception and spatially selective incremental refinement, repeating this cycle until the termination criterion is satisfied. Hierarchical experiments on biological surrogates and in vivo mouse cranial window creation demonstrate accurate anatomical prior transfer, reliable boundary adaptation, and autonomous precision milling of biological structures.
summary_zh: 生物结构的自主精密铣削受限于目标几何信息不完备、局部材料厚度未知、内部关键边界难以确定等问题。针对特定患者的术前模型可解决几何与厚度的个体差异问题，但静态模型无法判断执行过程中遇到的边界状态，而反复针对特定目标成像的方案可扩展性极差。本文提出一种考虑不确定性的自主铣削框架，将通用解剖先验与主动边界感知的功能互补结合：通用解剖先验提供保守的全局引导，通过语义引导配准与视觉-力混合校准转换为可由机器人执行的针对个体目标的引导策略。当铣削操作接近不确定边界时，机器人主动探测剩余结构，通过相对刚度变化估计边界状态与结构可分离性。状态自适应控制器负责切换主动感知与空间选择性增量细化模式，循环执行直至满足终止条件。针对生物替代物的分层实验与活体小鼠颅窗创建实验证明，该框架可实现精准的解剖先验迁移、可靠的边界自适应，完成生物结构的自主精密铣削。

title: Communication-Constrained Multi-Robot Exploration With Adaptive Communication Windows
title_zh: 带自适应通信窗口的通信约束多机器人探索方法
authors: Ben Rossano, Jaein Lim, Jonathan P. How
abstract: Exploring unknown environments with multi-robot teams can improve efficiency by allowing robots to explore in parallel. However, realizing these gains requires effective information sharing. When communication is intermittent, robots must balance the benefits of sharing information against the cost of diverting from exploration to establish communication. This paper introduces MACE, a decentralized exploration framework that actively evaluates whether establishing communication is worthwhile. At scheduled communication windows, robots estimate the cost of reaching previously identified communication locations. By formulating this decision as a variant of the Vehicle Orienteering Problem, robots evaluate routes based on the travel required to establish communication and the exploration that can be completed along the way. This approach enables robots to communicate more frequently than under purely opportunistic strategies while reducing the unnecessary travel associated with fixed rendezvous strategies. Across a set of simulated environments with varying size and geometry, we demonstrate that MACE reduces the total exploration time by up to 23% compared to existing communication-constrained exploration strategies.
summary_zh: 多机器人团队探索未知环境时可通过并行探索提升效率，但效率提升的前提是实现有效的信息共享。当通信链路不稳定时，机器人需要权衡信息共享的收益与偏离探索路径建立通信的成本。本文提出MACE，一种去中心化探索框架，可主动评估建立通信的收益是否高于成本。在预设的通信窗口，机器人估算抵达预先标记的通信点位的成本，将该决策建模为车辆定向问题的变体，综合评估建立通信所需的移动代价与沿途可完成的探索任务量，选择最优路径。与纯机会主义通信策略相比，该方法可提升机器人的通信频率，同时减少固定会合策略带来的不必要移动开销。在多组尺寸与几何特征各不相同的仿真环境中开展的实验表明，与现有通信约束下的探索策略相比，MACE最多可将总探索时间降低23%。

title: ArtManip: Category-Level Articulated In-Hand Manipulation
title_zh: ArtManip：面向类别级的铰接物体在手操作方法
authors: Yang Yang, Tengyu Liu, Puhao Li, Zeyuan Chen, Yuyang Li 等 (9 人)
abstract: Category-level in-hand manipulation of articulated objects is a formidable yet underexplored challenge for dexterous robotic hands. This difficulty stems from two core bottlenecks: first, controlling an object's internal degrees of freedom is tightly coupled with maintaining grasp stability on a free-floating base; second, acquiring diverse object models and functional grasps at scale is highly labor-intensive, yet vital for generalization given the system's sensitivity to initial configurations. In this work, we present ArtManip, the first category-level articulated in-hand manipulation method that generalizes across object instances and diverse initial grasps. For initial configuration construction, we develop an automated pipeline that procedurally generates diverse articulated objects and synthesizes task-oriented functional grasps. For policy learning, we propose a robust two-stage training strategy that incorporates articulation physics randomization, reward curriculum, and latent representation distillation to handle complex contact and joint dynamics during deployment. Extensive experiments across four object categories demonstrate that our policy generalizes to unseen instances and varied configurations in simulation, and achieves zero-shot transfer to 12 real-world objects featuring diverse shapes and joint mechanics.
summary_zh: 针对铰接物体的类别级在手操作是灵巧机械手领域极具挑战性且尚未得到充分探索的研究方向，该任务的难点来自两个核心瓶颈：第一，控制物体内部自由度与维持自由浮动基座的抓取稳定性高度耦合；第二，大规模获取多样化物体模型与功能性抓取样本的人力成本极高，但由于系统对初始配置高度敏感，这类样本对泛化能力至关重要。本文提出ArtManip，这是首个可跨物体实例、跨多样化初始抓取泛化的类别级铰接物体在手操作方法。针对初始配置构建环节，本文开发了自动化流水线，可程序化生成多样化铰接物体，合成面向任务的功能性抓取样本。针对策略学习环节，本文提出鲁棒的两阶段训练策略，融合铰接物理随机化、奖励课程学习与隐表征蒸馏技术，可应对部署过程中的复杂接触与关节动力学问题。在4类物体上开展的大量实验表明，本文提出的策略在仿真环境中可泛化至未见过的物体实例与不同配置，且可零样本迁移至12个形状与关节力学特性各不相同的真实世界物体。

title: PATH: Continuous Target Sensing among Autonomous Cooperative Drones
title_zh: PATH：自主协同无人机间的连续目标感知方法
authors: Heegyeong Kim, Alice James, Avishkar Seth, Endrowednes Kuantama, Jane Williamson 等 (7 人)
abstract: Continuous target sensing by uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) is constrained by limited flight endurance, motivating the transfer of tracking responsibility between cooperating UAVs. Such a handoff requires the receiver to identify the same physical target currently tracked by the sender despite differences in viewpoint, scale, and target appearance. Existing approaches based on global target localization or appearance-based cross-view association are limited by positioning uncertainty or ambiguous visual features. This paper presents Perspective Alignment \& Tracking Handoff (\textbf{PATH}), a platform-agnostic, geometry-assisted sensing and verification framework for target handoff between two moving UAVs. The sender reconstructs the tracked target as a metric 3D point using RGB-D sensing, while the receiver estimates its relative pose from a fiducial observation and projects the transmitted target point into its own image as a spatial prior for target acquisition. The receiver-generated candidate is then returned to the sender and verified through a cross-view Mutual Agreement Handshake before tracking responsibility is transferred. Real-world UAV experiments show mean relative-position and target-position errors of 0.047~m and 0.030~m, respectively. Under visually ambiguous conditions, PATH achieves 96.0\% frame-level receiver-side target acquisition accuracy, with 2.0\% false-positive and 2.0\% false-negative rates. A sensor-error sensitivity analysis shows that relative-pose uncertainty is the dominant contributor to receiver-view projection error. The implementation operates at video rate with compact inter-UAV communication below 16~kB/s at 60~Hz, demonstrating the feasibility of lightweight geometry-assisted target handoff on resource-constrained UAV platforms.
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）的连续目标感知受限于有限的飞行续航能力，需要在协同无人机之间完成跟踪责任的交接。这类交接过程要求接收方无人机能够识别出发送方无人机当前正在跟踪的同一物理目标，即使二者的观测视角、观测尺度、目标外观均存在差异。现有基于全局目标定位或基于外观的跨视角关联方法受限于定位不确定性或视觉特征歧义性。本文提出透视对齐与跟踪交接（Perspective Alignment & Tracking Handoff, PATH）框架，这是一种与平台无关、由几何信息辅助的双移动无人机间目标感知与验证框架。发送方无人机通过RGB-D传感将跟踪目标重建为度量3D点，接收方无人机通过基准标记观测估计自身相对位姿，将传输得到的目标点投影到自身图像中，作为目标捕获的空间先验。接收方生成的目标候选结果将返回给发送方，通过跨视角互认同步握手流程完成验证后，再完成跟踪责任的转移。真实无人机实验结果显示，该方法的平均相对位姿误差与目标位置误差分别为0.047m和0.030m。在视觉歧义场景下，PATH的接收端帧级目标捕获准确率可达96.0%，假阳性率与假阴性率均为2.0%。传感器误差敏感性分析表明，相对位姿不确定性是导致接收端视图投影误差的最主要因素。该方法可按视频帧率运行，60Hz频率下无人机间的通信数据量低于16kB/s，证明了在资源受限的无人机平台上实现轻量型几何辅助目标交接的可行性。

title: FoldNet++: a Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Robotic T-Shirt Folding and Unfolding
title_zh: FoldNet++：面向机器人T恤折叠与展开的大规模合成数据集
authors: Yuxing Chen, Zhiyuan Wei, Bowen Xiao, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang
abstract: Due to the highly deformable nature of garments, training a generalizable policy for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding remains a significant challenge. In this work, we present a large-scale synthetic dataset for robotic T-shirt folding and unfolding, covering 6 robotic embodiments, 1K T-shirts, 1K environmental assets, and 120K episodes with rich annotations, which can be used to train a wide range of manipulation policies. We first follow the FoldNet pipeline to generate a large-scale dataset of physically simulatable T-shirts with diverse appearances and annotated semantic keypoints. Based on these semantic keypoints, we then generate manipulation demonstrations for different robotic embodiments through a unified rule-based framework. We use these demonstrations to train visuomotor policies, and experimental results demonstrate that models trained solely on our synthetic data can achieve over 90\% end-to-end task success rates when directly deployed to unseen real-world environments and previously unseen T-shirts from arbitrary initial configurations. Project URL:this https URL.
summary_zh: 由于衣物具有高度可变形的特性，训练可泛化的机器人T恤折叠与展开操作策略始终是极具挑战性的任务。本文构建了面向机器人T恤折叠与展开的大规模合成数据集，覆盖6类机器人实体、1000件T恤、1000个环境资产，共包含12万条带丰富标注的任务片段，可用于训练各类操作策略。本文首先沿用FoldNet流水线生成大量物理可仿真的T恤样本，这些T恤外观多样且带有标注的语义关键点。基于这些语义关键点，本文进一步通过统一的规则化框架为不同机器人实体生成操作演示。利用这些演示训练视觉运动策略，实验结果表明，仅在本文合成数据集上训练得到的模型，直接部署到未见过的真实世界环境中、面对任意初始配置的未见过的T恤时，端到端任务成功率可超过90%。项目主页见对应链接。

title: Decentralized Evolution of Hexapod Gaits with Independent Leg Controllers
title_zh: 带独立腿部控制器的六足机器人步态去中心化进化方法
authors: Gary B. Parker, John Asaro, Jim O'Connor
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to hexapod locomotion by evolving each leg's gait independently through a decentralized evolutionary algorithm. Using the Webots simulator and the Mantis hexapod robot, we optimize individual leg controllers without centralized coordination, allowing emergent behaviors to drive the development of efficient, coordinated locomotion. Our decentralized method is benchmarked against cooperative coevolution, demonstrating improved efficacy in generating stable and adaptive gaits while showing interesting emergent coordination. By enabling independent evolution of leg controllers, this method reduces the complexity of gait optimization and highlights the potential of decentralized strategies for scalable and adaptive robotic systems.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种六足机器人运动控制新方法，通过去中心化进化算法独立进化每条腿的步态。该方法基于Webots仿真器与Mantis六足机器人平台，在无集中式协调的前提下优化单腿控制器，通过涌现行为生成高效、协调的运动模式。本文将该去中心化方法与协作协同进化方法进行基准对比，结果表明该方法生成稳定自适应步态的效率更高，且可产生有趣的涌现协调特性。通过实现腿部控制器的独立进化，该方法降低了步态优化的复杂度，证明了去中心化策略在可扩展自适应机器人系统领域的应用潜力。

title: Understanding Whole-Body Robot Teleoperation Strategies Under Diverse Task Objectives and Constraints
title_zh: 理解多任务目标与约束条件下的全身机器人遥操作策略
authors: Tsung-Chi Lin, Juo-Tung Chen, Chien-Ming Huang
abstract: This work investigates the control strategies of complex whole-body robot teleoperation that coordinate active perception, bimanual manipulation, and navigation. We developed a hybrid control framework, combining the free-form and constrained control, for the whole-body teleoperation of the TIAGo mobile manipulator. We conducted a user study to explore people's control strategies under different task constraints such as limited time and low tolerance of errors. Our results highlight the effective use of coordinated control in improving task efficiency and reducing the risk of reaching individual joint limits. We discuss our results and their implications for designing future whole-body robot teleoperation systems.
summary_zh: 本研究探究了协同主动感知、双手操作与导航的复杂全身机器人遥操作控制策略。研究团队开发了融合自由模式控制与约束控制的混合控制框架，用于TIAGo移动机械臂的全身遥操作。我们开展了用户研究，探索用户在时间受限、容错率低等不同任务约束下的控制策略。研究结果表明，协同控制的有效应用能够提升任务效率，降低机器人关节触及极限的风险。本文最后讨论了研究结果及其对未来全身机器人遥操作系统设计的启示。

title: READ: Learning Risk-Informed Fields for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
title_zh: READ：面向端到端自动驾驶的风险感知场学习框架
authors: Zhiyuan Liu, Yuanxin Tian, Zehong Ke, Jinhao Li, Hao Cheng 等 (8 人)
abstract: Autonomous driving requires more than recognizing what is present in a scene: a planner must determine how road structure, surrounding agents, and their motion states should influence a future maneuver. Existing learning-based planners can capture these influences through latent scene features and trajectory decoders, but the relationship between environmental factors and candidate actions often remains implicit. This limits the ability to inspect, diagnose, or refine how scene context affects the safety of a predicted trajectory. Classical safety fields provide an explicit spatial representation of this relationship, but their risk shapes and relative weights are prescribed in advance and do not adapt to each scene. We introduce READ, a framework that learns an explicit, planning-aligned risk representation from complementary geometric and behavioral constraints. READ instantiates this representation as a continuous spatiotemporal field, enabling differentiable queries along candidate trajectories. The learned field connects scene understanding with action selection by encouraging predicted trajectories to align with low-risk regions, while retaining a differentiable interface for trajectory evaluation and refinement. READ integrates with both end-to-end planners and Vision-Language-Action models. Experiments on NAVSIM show consistent gains across matched end-to-end backbones and strong performance in a VLA setting; READ also achieves competitive results on NAVSIM v2. These results establish learned spatial risk as an explicit, adaptable representation for safe planning.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶的要求不止于识别场景中的现有对象：规划器必须判断道路结构、周边智能体及其运动状态如何影响后续驾驶动作。现有基于学习的规划器可通过隐式场景特征与轨迹解码器捕捉上述影响，但环境因素与候选动作之间的关系通常是隐式的，这限制了场景上下文影响预测轨迹安全性的可检查、可诊断与可优化能力。传统安全场可提供该关系的显式空间表示，但其风险分布形态与相对权重均为预先设定，无法适配不同场景。本文提出READ（Risk-Informed Fields，风险感知场）框架，可从互补的几何约束与行为约束中学习与规划对齐的显式风险表示。READ将该表示实例化为连续时空场，支持沿候选轨迹的可微查询。该学习得到的风险场通过引导预测轨迹向低风险区域对齐，将场景理解与动作选择关联，同时保留用于轨迹评估与优化的可微接口。READ可同时与端到端规划器及Vision-Language-Action（VLA，视觉-语言-动作）模型集成。在NAVSIM数据集上的实验表明，该框架在各类端到端骨干模型上均实现了稳定性能提升，在VLA设置下表现优异，同时在NAVSIM v2数据集上也取得了有竞争力的结果。上述结果证明，学习得到的空间风险是适用于安全规划的显式、自适应表示方法。

title: A Deployable Architecture for Robot-Mediated Tasks (DART): Evaluation in Socially Assistive Robot-Guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Exercises
title_zh: 面向机器人介导任务的可部署架构DART：在社交辅助机器人引导认知行为疗法练习中的评估
authors: Mina Kian, Lydia Ignatova, Jiong Wang, Ji Min Lee, Jiancheng Li 等 (15 人)
abstract: Socially assistive robots (SARs) can support structured health and well-being interventions, but hardware and cost constraints limit interaction complexity and longitudinal real-world deployments. We present DART: Deployable Architecture for Robot-Mediated Tasks, an architecture that extends SARs through a web application and cloud infrastructure, enabling visual content, user input, remote computation, and persistent data storage synergistically with the robot's physical embodiment, speech, and movement. We evaluated DART by instantiating it in an interatively-developed full-stack HRI system for helping university students with elevated generalized anxiety to complete cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) homework exercises. The resulting system, which used the low-cost open-source Blossom robot platform, was refined and evaluated through a participatory design process and multiple user studies, and finally evaluated in an in-lab study with 103 participants, and then a six-week in-home deployment with four participants. In the in-lab evaluation, participants showed significant within-session reductions in stress, state anxiety, and negative affect, and gave the platform a mean System Usability Scale score of 78.89. In the home deployment, the mean System Usability Scale score was 87.5, with positive qualitative feedback on usability. Participants across both groups identified speech input, visual presentation, and web-robot synchronization as priorities for improvement. These findings validate DART as an effective architecture for extending the capabilities of a low-cost SAR in both in-lab single-session and in real-world longitudinal deployments.
summary_zh: 社交辅助机器人（Socially Assistive Robots, SARs）可支持结构化的健康与福祉干预，但硬件与成本约束限制了其交互复杂度与长期真实场景部署能力。本文提出DART（Deployable Architecture for Robot-Mediated Tasks，机器人介导任务可部署架构），该架构通过网页应用与云基础设施扩展SAR的能力，实现视觉内容展示、用户输入、远程计算与持久化数据存储功能，与机器人的实体交互、语音、运动能力形成协同。我们将DART实例化为迭代开发的全栈人机交互系统，用于帮助存在广泛性焦虑症状的大学生完成认知行为疗法（Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, CBT）家庭练习，以此对该架构进行评估。该系统采用低成本开源Blossom机器人平台，经参与式设计流程与多轮用户研究迭代优化后，先后完成了包含103名受试者的实验室研究，以及覆盖4名受试者的为期6周的居家部署实验。实验室评估结果显示，受试者在实验过程中的压力、状态焦虑与负面情绪均出现显著下降，平台的系统可用性量表（System Usability Scale）平均得分为78.89。居家部署阶段的系统可用性量表平均得分为87.5，受试者对可用性给出了大量正面定性反馈。两组受试者均将语音输入、视觉展示、网页-机器人同步列为后续优化的优先方向。上述结果验证了DART作为有效架构，可在实验室单会话场景与真实场景长期部署中扩展低成本SAR的能力边界。

title: DWMP: Leveraging Dual World Models for Humanoid Obstacle Traversal
title_zh: DWMP：利用双世界模型实现人形机器人障碍物通行
authors: Rongjun Jin, Jianming Ma, Yue Gao
abstract: Humanoid robots must traverse cluttered obstacle fields using onboard proprioceptive and visual observations, yet existing methods usually process multimodal observations without explicitly considering their different characteristics: proprioceptive observations are low-dimensional but governed by highly nonlinear robot dynamics, while egocentric visual observations are high-dimensional, noisy, and redundant. We propose DWMP (Dual World Model Policy), a framework that provides the actor with separate but complementary world-model representations for humanoid obstacle traversal. A Koopman-based dynamics world model lifts proprioceptive observations into a latent space where their temporal evolution is approximately linear, making the dynamics features easier for the actor to learn from. An RSSM-based visual world model compresses egocentric depth observations into compact stochastic states while preserving obstacle-related geometry. The student policy receives the fused latent representation for action generation, combining linearized proprioceptive dynamics with compressed visual perception. Experiments in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot show that DWMP improves obstacle traversal performance over baselines and supports real-world deployment under randomized obstacle layouts.
summary_zh: 人形机器人需要依靠本体感知与视觉观测在杂乱障碍物场景中通行，但现有方法通常处理多模态观测时未明确考虑两类观测的特性差异：本体感知观测维度低，但受高度非线性的机器人动力学约束；第一视角视觉观测维度高、存在噪声且存在冗余。本文提出DWMP（Dual World Model Policy，双世界模型策略）框架，为人形机器人障碍物通行任务的执行器提供相互独立且互补的世界模型表示。其中基于Koopman的动力学世界模型将本体感知观测映射到隐空间，使观测的时间演化近似呈线性，降低执行器学习动力学特征的难度；基于RSSM（Recurrent State Space Model，循环状态空间模型）的视觉世界模型将第一视角深度观测压缩为紧凑的随机状态，同时保留与障碍物相关的几何信息。策略网络接收融合后的隐表示生成动作，融合了线性化的本体动力学特征与压缩后的视觉感知结果。在仿真环境与宇树G1人形机器人平台上的实验表明，DWMP相比基线方法提升了障碍物通行性能，可在随机障碍物布局的真实场景中部署运行。

title: The Iterative Equivariant Filter
title_zh: 迭代等变滤波器
authors: Pieter van Goor, James Richard Forbes
abstract: This paper presents the iterative equivariant filter (IterEqF). The iterative extended Kalman filter (IterEKF) replaces the standard EKF correction step with an iterative correction step that is the Gauss-Newton solution to a nonlinear weighted least squares problem. The standard equivariant filter (EqF) exploits and respects the underlying symmetry of state estimation problems posed on homogeneous spaces and Lie groups. The motivation behind the IterEqF is to combine the features of both the IterEKF and the EqF, thus leading to a high-performance state estimation solution that is well suited to navigation problems. This paper derives the iteration procedure for the IterEqF update step and shows how the intrinsic nonlinearity of the approach naturally results in a `reset' of the filter's covariance into new coordinates. Monte-Carlo simulations of range-based localisation for a mobile robot demonstrate the improvement in performance relative to a standard EqF, especially during the transient convergence.
summary_zh: 本文提出迭代等变滤波器（iterative equivariant filter, IterEqF）。迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波器（Iterative Extended Kalman Filter, IterEKF）将标准扩展卡尔曼滤波器的校正步骤替换为迭代校正步骤，该步骤是针对非线性加权最小二乘问题的高斯-牛顿解。标准等变滤波器（Equivariant Filter, EqF）利用并适配定义在齐次空间与李群上的状态估计问题的底层对称性。IterEqF的设计初衷是融合IterEKF与EqF的特性，得到适配导航问题的高性能状态估计方案。本文推导了IterEqF更新步骤的迭代流程，证明该方法的固有非线性特性可自然实现滤波器协方差在新坐标下的“重置”。针对移动机器人基于测距的定位任务开展的蒙特卡洛仿真表明，IterEqF相比标准EqF性能有所提升，尤其在瞬态收敛阶段优势明显。

title: DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task and Motion Planning for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Samrat Sahoo, Yixuan Huang, Tom Silver
abstract: Collecting high-quality robot data remains a fundamental challenge for training robot foundation models. Task and motion planning (TAMP) offers a scalable way to generate demonstrations, but our experiments show that raw TAMP trajectories provide surprisingly little benefit when used to fine-tune pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models, despite successfully solving the target tasks. We hypothesize that this failure arises from a behavioral distribution mismatch between planner-generated trajectories and the data used to pretrain the VLA. To address this mismatch, we introduce DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task And motion planning for Fine-tuning A Robot foundation Model, an approach that incorporates the pretraining distribution directly into TAMP trajectory generation. DATAFARM aligns generated trajectories with the pretraining data in robot joint configurations, motion style, and temporal execution profiles. We evaluate DATAFARM on three tabletop manipulation tasks that TAMP can perform and a cloth-folding task beyond the capability of TAMP. DATAFARM achieves an average success rate of 56.7%, substantially outperforming raw TAMP (8.3%) while approaching human teleoperation (61.7%). On Deformable Object Manipulation, which is outside the fine-tuning distribution, the fine-tuned model retains 85% success, compared with 90% for the pretrained model. These results show that aligning planner-generated demonstrations with the pretraining distribution can make TAMP an effective source of data for VLA fine-tuning. Website and code:this https URL

title: Mission Performance: Automatic and Adaptive Race Pace Progression for Autonomous Racing
title_zh: 任务性能：面向自主赛车的自动自适应赛车进度推进方法
authors: Giovanni Lambertini, Matteo Pini, Nicola Musiu, Ayoub Raji, Francesco Iacovacci 等 (6 人)
abstract: In this paper, we describe the Mission Performance module implemented for a fully autonomous racing car to automatically manage the longitudinal, lateral, and combined performances, aiming to speedup the laptime progression while assuring safety. Motivated by the difficulty and risks of applying the real-time estimation of the grip to critical modules like the motion planner and controller, the Mission Performance guides these modules adapting their target performance instead of changing the vehicle model parameters. The module is formed by pre-defined progressions to warm up the tires at the beginning of a run. Then, the system continuously monitors safety and vehicle dynamics metrics on a per-sector basis to adaptively reduce, maintain, or increase the performance levels for each sector, progressively converging toward the maximum allowed value. The solution's effectiveness is demonstrated on the EAV-25, a fully autonomous Dallara Superformula, at the Yas Marina Circuit during the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League (A2RL) Season 2.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了为全自主赛车开发的任务性能模块，该模块可自动管理纵向、横向及组合行驶性能，在保障安全的前提下缩短单圈用时。针对将抓地力实时估计应用于运动规划器、控制器等核心模块存在的难度与风险问题，该任务性能模块通过引导上述模块自适应调整目标性能，而非修改车辆模型参数实现优化。该模块首先通过预定义的进度策略在行驶初始阶段完成轮胎预热，随后系统持续逐段监测安全与车辆动力学指标，自适应地对每个路段的性能水平进行降阶、保持或升阶，逐步收敛到允许的最大性能值。该方案在阿布扎比自主赛车联赛（A2RL）第二季的亚斯码头赛道上，基于全自主Dallara Superformula赛车EAV-25完成了有效性验证。

title: Amortized Low-Rank Adaptation for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向基于模型强化学习的摊销低秩适配方法
authors: Fernando Palafox, David Fridovich-Keil
abstract: World models let agents plan by predicting the consequences of their actions, but changes in the environment can make them inaccurate. We study the problem of adapting a world model to an unknown test-time environment, drawn from a known environment family, using only a few episodes of interaction. Existing approaches trade off computational cost against expressivity, i.e., the range of models a method can produce. For example, in-context learning is computationally cheap but limited in expressivity, and gradient-based adaptation is expressive but computationally expensive. We present CLAW (Context-conditioned Low-rank Adaptation of World models), which addresses this tradeoff by using a hypernetwork to generate low-rank (LoRA) adapters at test time. During pretraining, we simulate adaptation to a variety of environments and jointly train the hypernetwork and base world model. At test time, we freeze the base model and use a forward pass of the hypernetwork to generate adapters from a small batch of test-time transitions. We evaluate CLAW in locomotion and manipulation environment families that vary in dynamics, embodiment, and reward. We show that, using only seconds of test-time data, CLAW outperforms gradient-based adaptation and in-context learning during online adaptation. We also show that CLAW avoids overfitting in data-scarce regimes, that its advantage comes from the expressive adapters rather than context conditioning, and that pretraining the hypernetwork jointly with the base model outperforms training it post hoc.
summary_zh: 世界模型可让智能体通过预测动作后果完成规划，但环境变化会导致世界模型精度下降。本文研究仅利用少量交互片段，将世界模型适配到从已知环境族中采样得到的未知测试环境的问题。现有方法在计算成本与表达能力之间存在权衡，即方法可生成的模型范围受限：例如上下文学习计算成本低但表达能力有限，基于梯度的适配方法表达能力强但计算开销大。本文提出CLAW（Context-conditioned Low-rank Adaptation of World models，世界模型的上下文条件低秩适配）方法，通过超网络在测试阶段生成低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）器解决上述权衡问题。预训练阶段，我们模拟对多种环境的适配过程，联合训练超网络与基础世界模型。测试阶段，冻结基础模型，通过超网络的一次前向传播，从少量测试时刻的转移样本中生成适配器。我们在动力学、本体形态、奖励函数存在差异的移动与操作环境族中对CLAW进行评估，结果表明仅使用数秒的测试数据，CLAW在在线适配阶段的表现就优于基于梯度的适配方法与上下文学习方法。同时实验证明CLAW可在数据稀缺场景下避免过拟合，其性能优势来自表达能力优异的适配器而非上下文条件，且超网络与基础模型联合预训练的效果优于事后单独训练超网络的效果。

title: Pneumatic neurons for soft robots enable inflate-and-fire networks for rhythmic motion
title_zh: 软机器人气动神经元可实现用于节律运动的充气激发网络
authors: Dongting Li, Michael Tolley, Nick Gravish
abstract: Animals coordinate their movements through distributed neural circuits, but soft robots still typically depend on external, centralized electronics for control. Building soft robots that operate without centralized electronic controllers while remaining responsive to their environment remains a frontier challenge in soft robotics. In this work we introduce a soft-robot control architecture inspired by leaky integrate-and-fire models of biological neural circuits. The Pneumatic neuron (Pneu-ron) is a soft actuator that unifies energy conversion, logic, and actuation in one component. Each module combines a low-boiling-point fluid (LBF), a heater, and a mechanical switch into a self-excitable unit. Boiling the LBF inflates the module and triggers excitation and inhibition of adjacent modules in a process we call "inflate-and-fire". When interconnected into excitatory-inhibitory rings, Pneu-rons generate stable, sequential oscillations whose frequency emerges from the material dynamics and environmental conditions. By harnessing the inflation of Pneu-rons for actuation these networks can drive oscillatory locomotion of soft robots. Pneu-ron networks sustain oscillation under mechanical load and thermal variations, adapting through material physics rather than computation. Dynamical modeling of these networks reveals a dimensionless bifurcation diagram that dictates the network's oscillatory behavior. Encoding logic and actuation into material-level modules presents a new avenue for adaptive, electronics controller-free, soft robots.
summary_zh: 动物通过分布式神经回路协调运动，但当前软机器人通常仍依赖外部集中式电子设备实现控制。构建无需集中式电子控制器、同时可对环境做出响应的软机器人，是软机器人领域的前沿挑战。本研究提出一种受生物神经回路漏泄积分放电模型启发的软机器人控制架构。气动神经元（Pneu-ron）是将能量转换、逻辑运算与驱动功能集成在单个组件中的软执行器，每个模块由低沸点流体（LBF）、加热器与机械开关组成，构成自激励单元。低沸点流体沸腾后会使模块膨胀，触发相邻模块的兴奋与抑制，该过程被称为“充气激发”。当多个气动神经元互联形成兴奋-抑制环时，可生成稳定的顺序振荡，其振荡频率由材料动力学特性与环境条件共同决定。通过利用气动神经元的膨胀实现驱动，这类网络可驱动软机器人完成振荡式运动。气动神经元网络可在机械负载与温度变化条件下维持振荡，通过材料物理特性而非计算实现自适应。对该类网络的动力学建模得到了可描述网络振荡行为的无量纲分岔图。将逻辑与驱动功能编码到材料级模块，为开发无需电子控制器的自适应软机器人提供了新路径。

title: Trajectory Bundle Method in SE(3) for Black-Box Fixed-Wing Aircraft Trajectory Optimization
title_zh: SE(3)（特殊欧几里得群）空间下面向黑盒固定翼飞行器轨迹优化的轨迹束方法
authors: Matthew D. Osburn, Cameron K. Peterson, John L. Salmon
abstract: Dynamically feasible trajectory optimization for rigid-body systems is naturally formulated on the special Euclidean group SE(3) but is challenging when dynamics are available only as black-box computations without derivatives. This paper formulates the Trajectory Bundle Method (TBM) for motion planning implicitly on SE(3). Bundles are constructed in the Lie algebra and propagated through nonlinear rigid-body dynamics using exponential and logarithmic maps, enabling derivative-free planning of non-Euclidean trajectories. We show that Euclidean TBM interpolation error is bounded quadratically by bundle diameter and extend this result to SE(3), where the bound additionally depends on a local Lipschitz constant of the Log map. Numerical experiments corroborate these bounds. Finally, we demonstrate SE(3) TBM by optimizing an acrobatic, collision-free fixed-wing maneuver through a rotated aperture without explicit models or derivatives of the vehicle dynamics, aerodynamics, or collision model.
summary_zh: 刚体系统的动力学可行轨迹优化问题可自然定义在特殊欧几里得群SE(3)空间中，但当动力学仅以无导数的黑盒计算形式提供时，该问题求解难度较高。本文在SE(3)空间中隐式构建了轨迹束方法（Trajectory Bundle Method, TBM）用于运动规划：在李代数空间中构建轨迹束，通过指数映射与对数映射完成非线性刚体动力学的传播，实现非欧几里得轨迹的无导数规划。本文证明欧几里得空间下TBM的插值误差与轨迹束直径呈二次有界关系，并将该结论扩展到SE(3)空间，此时误差界额外依赖于对数映射的局部利普希茨常数。数值实验验证了上述误差界的正确性。最后本文通过优化固定翼飞行器穿过旋转孔径的无碰撞特技动作，验证了SE(3) TBM的有效性，该过程无需飞行器动力学、空气动力学或碰撞模型的显式表达式与导数信息。

title: DIA: Denoising Intermediate Advantage for Diffusion Policy Optimization
title_zh: DIA：面向扩散策略优化的去噪中间优势方法
authors: Arjun Sohal, Yuchi Zhao, Miroslav Bogdanovic, Alan Aspuru-Guzik
abstract: Diffusion-based robot policies have become widely used in robotic manipulation, where they are typically trained with behavior cloning. However, policies trained purely from demonstrations are limited by the quality and coverage of the available data. Reinforcement learning can further improve the performance of these pretrained policies through interaction. A common approach is to use policy-gradient methods that formulate diffusion-policy fine-tuning as an outer environment MDP together with an inner denoising MDP. However, existing methods typically assign the same environment-level credit to all denoising steps used to construct an action chunk, without distinguishing which intermediate decisions contributed most to the final return. We introduce Denoising Intermediate Advantage (DIA), a policy-gradient method that learns a value function over partially denoised actions and uses it to construct a denoising- level advantage for each step of the generative process. DIA com- bines this inner credit signal with the standard environment-level PPO advantage, providing state-dependent credit throughout the denoising chain. Across Robomimic, FurnitureBench, Franka Kitchen, and D3IL, DIA consistently improves final performance over existing diffusion-policy fine-tuning methods. Beyond final reward, DIA reaches successful states more efficiently and can shift farther from the pretrained behavior distribution, enabling it to discover more effective and efficient task-level strategies and subtask sequences that baseline methods fail to reach.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的机器人策略已在机器人操作领域得到广泛应用，这类策略通常通过行为克隆完成训练。然而，仅从演示数据训练得到的策略会受限于可用数据的质量与覆盖范围。强化学习可通过交互进一步提升这类预训练策略的性能，主流思路是采用策略梯度方法，将扩散策略微调建模为外层环境马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）与内层去噪MDP的组合。但现有方法通常为用于构建动作块的所有去噪步骤分配相同的环境级信用，无法区分哪些中间决策对最终回报的贡献最大。本文提出去噪中间优势（Denoising Intermediate Advantage, DIA）这一策略梯度方法，可在部分去噪动作上学习价值函数，为生成过程的每一步构建去噪层级的优势值。DIA将该内层信用信号与标准环境级近端策略优化（PPO）优势相结合，在整个去噪链中提供依赖于状态的信用分配机制。在Robomimic、FurnitureBench、Franka Kitchen和D3IL多个基准测试集上的实验表明，DIA相比现有扩散策略微调方法可稳定提升最终性能。除最终奖励提升外，DIA能够更高效地抵达成功状态，且可更大程度偏离预训练行为分布，从而发现基线方法无法实现的更高效的任务级策略与子任务序列。

title: Chain-SLAM: Globally Consistent Backend for Multi-Session LiDAR SLAM via Chained Loop Closure
title_zh: Chain-SLAM：基于链式回环检测的多会话激光SLAM全局一致性后端
authors: Zhiheng Li, Xinhao Liu, Juexiao Zhang, Yongqing Liang, Chen Feng
abstract: Maintaining consistency over long spatial and temporal horizons remains a fundamental challenge in large-scale LiDAR SLAM, particularly when integrating maps collected across multiple sessions. We present Chain-SLAM, a LiDAR SLAM backend enabling online multi-session map alignment and reuse with global consistency at large scale. We implement a chained loop closure mechanism that efficiently propagates geometric constraints across inter-session keyframes through an adjacency graph, enabling robust long-horizon consistency triggered by reliable short-horizon loop closures. The system initializes inter-session alignment with GNSS-proximity place recognition, then performs on-the-fly loop closure detections and joint optimization of loaded maps and newly acquired trajectories within a unified factor graph, maintaining both inter- and intra-session geometric consistency without dynamic object removal, and cross-platform robustness with minimal hyperparameter tuning. Experimental results show improved trajectory accuracy and robust multi-session integration on large-scale datasets. We release our source code to support reproducible research in large-scale multi-session LiDAR SLAM. Project site:this https URL
summary_zh: 在大尺度激光同时定位与建图（LiDAR SLAM）任务中，尤其是整合多会话采集的地图时，维持长时空跨度下的一致性始终是核心挑战。本文提出Chain-SLAM这一激光SLAM后端系统，可在大尺度场景下支持在线多会话地图对齐与复用，同时保证全局一致性。系统实现了链式回环检测机制，可通过邻接图在跨会话关键帧之间高效传播几何约束，依托可靠的短跨度回环检测触发鲁棒的长跨度一致性维护。系统首先通过全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）邻近性的地点识别完成跨会话对齐初始化，随后在统一因子图中对已加载地图和新采集轨迹执行实时回环检测与联合优化，无需移除动态对象即可同时维持会话间与会话内的几何一致性，仅需极少超参数调优即可实现跨平台鲁棒性。大规模数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法可提升轨迹精度，实现鲁棒的多会话地图整合。本文已开源源代码，为大尺度多会话激光SLAM领域的可复现研究提供支持，项目主页见提供的链接。

title: Guardrailed Meta-Agent Loops: Stress-Testing Policy Pinning, Budget Bounds, and Crash Recovery
title_zh: 带防护机制的元智能体循环：策略固定、预算边界与崩溃恢复的压力测试
authors: Qinzhen Ma, Jialin Wu
abstract: Self-improving agent workflows create an audit problem when the same controller can change both its behavior and the conditions under which that behavior is judged. We present GuardrailLoop, a simulation-based testbed that makes three operational contracts jointly testable: preservation of human-defined policy, compute accounting at every recorded execution prefix, and recovery of a specified scientific state after crashes. A hash-pinned policy fixes goals, scope, evaluation identity, budget, and release conditions; machine-directed evolution is restricted to a code-owned feature catalog and bounded knobs. The contribution is an executable boundary and an evaluation protocol that separates useful adaptation, state recovery, and repeated execution. In a paired 50-seed 2 x 2 study, round-stage growth changes target attainment by +1.00 and restricted mean compute to target by -56.97 simulated GPU-hours (95% paired-bootstrap interval [-58.91,-54.70]); idle growth has zero measured utility effect. Across 240 enumerated crash injections, all runs recover the defined outcome, but only 210 preserve the normalized trace: 30 pre-commit crashes repeat a planner call. Resource-drift, kill-switch, integrity, and output-guard matrices satisfy their specified checks. These findings show why successful outcome recovery is insufficient evidence of exactly-once execution. They establish conformance within one calibrated deterministic testbed, rather than general safety or real-world self-improvement.
summary_zh: 当同一控制器既可以改变自身行为，又可以改变行为评判的规则时，自改进智能体工作流就会产生审计难题。本文提出GuardrailLoop这一基于仿真的测试平台，可对三项运行契约进行联合测试：人类定义策略的保留、每段已记录执行前缀的算力核算、崩溃后指定科学状态的恢复。其中哈希固定策略可锁定目标、作用范围、评估身份、预算与发布条件，机器引导的进化过程被限制在代码所属的功能目录与有界可调参数范围内。本文的贡献在于提出了可执行的边界规则与评估协议，将有效自适应、状态恢复与重复执行三类行为进行了区分。在包含50个随机种子的2×2配对对照实验中，分阶段增长机制将目标达成率提升了1.00，将达成目标所需的平均受限算力降低了56.97仿真GPU小时（95%配对自举区间为[-58.91,-54.70]）；而空闲增长机制未观测到任何效用提升。在240次枚举的崩溃注入测试中，所有运行都可恢复定义的输出结果，但仅有210次保留了归一化执行轨迹：剩余30次预提交崩溃会重复执行规划器调用。资源漂移、紧急停止、完整性与输出防护矩阵均通过了指定校验。上述结果表明，仅靠输出结果成功恢复不足以证明执行过程满足恰好一次语义，本文在经过校准的确定性测试床内验证了相关机制的合规性，而非泛化的安全性或现实世界自改进能力。

title: An Automated Thickness Evaluation Procedure Using an Integrated Structured Light 3D Camera in a Robotic Bioprinting Framework
title_zh: 机器人生物打印框架中集成结构光3D相机的自动化厚度评估方法
authors: Ehsan Zobeidi, Omid Rezayof, Farshid Alambeigi
abstract: Bioprinting is emerging as a tissue engineering technique to replace common treatment methods for large scale injuries. While thickness of the BioPrinted Constructs (BPCs) have shown to be of importance in the cell maturation and integration, the literature lacks a robust, automated, and quantitative method for measuring these metrics. In this paper, we propose a fully automated vision-based method for measuring the thickness of the BPCs with complex geometries. Leveraging the point cloud and RGB images of a structured light 3D camera, our proposed method performs an image-based segmentation for delineating the BPCs from the RGB images, accompanied by novel geometry-based thickness measurement algorithms performed on the point cloud scans. These algorithms combine the segmentation mask with the robot's forward kinematics data and a 3D point cloud scan to precisely measure the aforementioned metrics for complex-shaped BPCs. The proposed method was evaluated in simulation and experimental studies. In simulation studies, the algorithms were used to measure the thickness of some virtually created BPCs with known thickness. The comparison between the measured and true thicknesses demonstrates the high accuracy of the proposed method, achieving mean absolute errors between 0.025 mm and 0.057 mm in simulation at a spatial resolution of 0.1 mm x 0.1 mm per pixel. Furthermore, we successfully deployed the algorithms on our robotic bioprinting setup utilizing a structure light 3D camera, where complex patterns were printed and the developed methods utilized to accurately measure the thickness of printed BPCs.
summary_zh: 生物打印作为一种组织工程技术，正在逐步替代针对大面积损伤的传统治疗方案。生物打印结构体（BioPrinted Constructs, BPCs）的厚度对细胞成熟与整合过程至关重要，但现有研究中仍缺乏鲁棒、自动化、可定量的测量方法。本文提出一种完全基于视觉的自动化方法，用于测量复杂几何形态生物打印结构体的厚度。该方法利用结构光3D相机输出的点云与RGB图像，首先从RGB图像中执行基于图像的分割，将生物打印结构体从背景中分离，随后在点云扫描结果上运行新型的基于几何的厚度测量算法。该算法将分割掩码、机器人正向运动学数据与3D点云扫描结果相结合，可对复杂形态生物打印结构体的厚度实现高精度测量。本文通过仿真与实体实验对所提方法进行了验证：仿真实验中对已知厚度的虚拟生物打印结构体进行测量，测量值与真实值的对比结果证明所提方法精度极高，在空间分辨率为0.1mm×0.1mm每像素的仿真场景下，平均绝对误差介于0.025mm到0.057mm之间。此外，本文将该算法部署到搭载结构光3D相机的机器人生物打印平台上，成功打印了复杂图案并使用所提方法完成了生物打印结构体厚度的高精度测量。

title: Battery-Aware Predictive Trajectory Planning and Control for Multirotors Under Disturbances
title_zh: 扰动环境下多旋翼无人机的电池感知预测轨迹规划与控制
authors: Krishna Bhavithavya Kidambi
abstract: This paper presents a battery-aware predictive trajectory-planning and control framework for multirotors operating under spatially localized disturbances. Candidate trajectories are evaluated through closed-loop vehicle--motor--battery propagation, allowing disturbance-induced control demand, electrical energy, battery evolution, and terminal-voltage-dependent actuator capability to enter the planning process. % A reduced-order battery model is numerically benchmarked against an independently implemented Simscape equivalent-circuit reference, with a power NRMSE of $0.64\%$ and a cumulative-energy discrepancy below $0.7\%$. % In a $150$-s, $640$-m mission containing three disturbance regions, the selected trajectory reduces electrical energy consumption by $7.46\%$ and position-tracking RMSE by approximately $72\%$ relative to the disturbance-aware fixed-reference baseline. % Planner ablations show that battery-dependent terms are nonbinding at nominal SOC but alter the selected trajectory under a depleted-battery stress condition. % Execution with multiple feedback controllers further demonstrates that controller selection changes the tradeoff among tracking accuracy, energy consumption, and actuator utilization. % The results demonstrate the benefit of accounting for predicted closed-loop energetic and battery--actuator consequences during trajectory selection.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向空间局部扰动环境下运行的多旋翼无人机的电池感知预测轨迹规划与控制框架。该框架通过闭环的飞行器-电机-电池传播模型对候选轨迹进行评估，将扰动引发的控制需求、电能消耗、电池状态演化以及依赖于端电压的执行器能力全部纳入规划流程。本文将降阶电池模型与独立实现的Simscape等效电路参考模型进行数值基准对比，得到功率归一化均方根误差为0.64%，累计能量偏差低于0.7%。在包含3个扰动区域、时长150s、航程640m的任务中，所选轨迹相比具备扰动感知能力的固定参考基线方案，电能消耗降低7.46%，位置跟踪均方根误差降低约72%。规划器消融实验表明，在标称荷电状态下，与电池相关的约束项不会成为绑定约束，但在电池电量耗尽的压力场景下会改变最终选择的轨迹。多种反馈控制器下的执行结果进一步表明，控制器选型会改变跟踪精度、能耗与执行器利用率三者之间的权衡关系。上述结果证明，在轨迹选择阶段考虑预测得到的闭环能量特性与电池-执行器联动效应可带来显著收益。

title: A Physics-Based Closed-Loop Robotic Bioprinting Framework Towards Volumetric Muscle Loss Treatment
title_zh: 面向体积性肌肉损失治疗的基于物理的闭环机器人生物打印框架
authors: Omid Rezayof, Jerin T. Andrews, Ehsan Zobeidi, Ali Ghasemkhani, Meenakshi Kamaraj 等 (8 人)
abstract: Robotic bioprinting and Direct Ink Writing (DIW) are being explored towards the treatment of Volumetric Muscle Loss (VML). While previous studies have shown the importance of proper parameter selection on the print outcome, existing approaches often rely on time- and material-intensive design of experiments methods, or require large, well-curated datasets for training machine learning models. In this paper, we propose a physics-based closed-loop robotic bioprinting system capable of near real-time parameter adaptation. The system integrates a 3D point cloud camera and fully autonomous vision-based algorithms to provide quantitative evaluation of printed constructs. This evaluation is fed into a controller that adjusts printing parameters to achieve a desired bead thickness. To assess the framework's performance, four experimental configurations were tested, each repeated three times. In these tests, printing began from an arbitrary initial parameter value, and the controller was tasked with adjusting the parameters to reach the desired thickness. The system converged in all trials, achieving a tracking error below 0.5 mm within an average of 5.2 seconds from the start of printing. The low standard deviation of the converged pressure over different tests (0.04 bar on average) demonstrates robustness and repeatability. Additional experiments were conducted with the controller turned off, enabling direct comparison with open-loop DIW bioprinting, further confirming the effectiveness of the proposed closed-loop framework in achieving the desired bead geometry.
summary_zh: 机器人生物打印与直写成型（Direct Ink Writing, DIW）技术正在被探索用于体积性肌肉损失（Volumetric Muscle Loss, VML）的治疗。尽管已有研究证明合理的参数选择对打印结果至关重要，但现有方法通常依赖耗时耗料的实验设计方法，或是需要大量经过精心标注的数据集来训练机器学习模型。本文提出一种基于物理的闭环机器人生物打印系统，可实现近实时的参数自适应。该系统集成3D点云相机与完全自主的视觉算法，可对打印得到的结构体进行定量评估，评估结果将输入控制器，由控制器调整打印参数以实现目标丝材厚度。为评估该框架的性能，本文设置了4组实验配置，每组重复3次。所有测试均从任意初始参数值开始打印，控制器负责调整参数以达到目标厚度。所有实验中系统均成功收敛，从打印开始平均仅需5.2秒即可将跟踪误差控制在0.5mm以下。不同测试下收敛后的压力标准差极低（平均仅0.04bar），证明系统具备鲁棒性与可复现性。本文额外在关闭控制器的条件下开展了对照实验，与开环直写生物打印方案进行直接对比，进一步验证了所提闭环框架在实现目标丝材几何形态上的有效性。

title: A Data-Driven Distributed Control Scheme: Learning Multi-Objective Agent-Based MPC for Path-Tracking
title_zh: 数据驱动分布式控制方案：面向路径跟踪的多目标智能体模型预测控制学习
authors: Jiaming Zhong, Reza Valiollahi Mehrizi, Yash Vardhan Pant, Amir Khajepour
abstract: Agent-based model predictive control (AMPC) has recently been proposed for vehicle systems with various controllers, such as differential braking and torque vectoring, where controllers are regarded as distributed agents contributing to the same objective. However, this scheme is challenging in handling multiple conflicting objectives with coupled agents. A common approach for such tasks is the integrated MPC, where all objectives and agents are stacked together in one optimization. Nevertheless, as more agents and objectives are involved, the integrated MPC will face challenges like computational burdens and maintenance difficulties in practice. To this end, this paper proposes a learning multi-objective AMPC that can improve design flexibility and computing efficiency. First, under the assumption of information exchange, a multi-objective AMPC tailored from the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is proposed to decouple the system and achieve the same performance as the integrated scheme iteratively. Second, a learning-based method for initializing iterations is proposed to accelerate convergence. In addition, a data management method is proposed for real-time efficiency, and an authentication module is designed for learning reliability. We compare the proposed scheme against the integrated scheme via a combined path-tracking simulation for autonomous vehicles with various controllers. The proposed scheme achieves the same control performance as the integrated one while reducing the computational time by 43.5%. Furthermore, the learning-based method saves 88.6% more computational time than without learning, making it suitable for real-time implementation.
summary_zh: 基于智能体的模型预测控制（Agent-based Model Predictive Control, AMPC）近期被提出用于搭载差分制动、转矩矢量分配等多种控制器的车辆系统，这类方案将各个控制器视为分布式智能体，共同服务于同一控制目标。但该方案在处理存在耦合智能体的多个冲突目标时仍存在挑战，这类任务的主流传统方法是集成式模型预测控制（MPC），即将所有目标与智能体整合到同一个优化问题中。但随着智能体与目标数量的增加，集成式MPC在实际应用中会面临计算负担过重、维护难度大等问题。针对该问题，本文提出一种可提升设计灵活性与计算效率的学习型多目标AMPC方案：首先在信息交互的假设下，基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）设计定制化多目标AMPC，对系统解耦，通过迭代达到与集成式方案相当的性能；其次提出迭代初始化的学习方法以加速收敛；此外还设计了数据管理方法以保障实时效率，设计了认证模块以提升学习可靠性。本文通过自动驾驶车辆多控制器联合路径跟踪仿真，将所提方案与集成式方案进行对比，结果表明所提方案可达到与集成式方案完全相当的控制性能，同时计算耗时降低43.5%；其中基于学习的初始化方法相比无学习的方案可进一步节省88.6%的计算时间，完全满足实时部署要求。

title: Multi-Objective Agent-Based Model Predictive Controller for Plug-and-Play Vehicle Control
title_zh: 面向即插即用车辆控制的多目标智能体模型预测控制器
authors: Jiaming Zhong, Ladan Khoshnevisan, Shucheng Huang, Mohammad Pirani, Yash Vardhan Pant 等 (6 人)
abstract: Functional integration is a growing trend in vehicle control, often involving the coordination of multiple controllers to achieve various objectives simultaneously. The need for flexibility and reliability has led to a "plug-and-play" approach in control system design, which presents challenges for traditional integrated model predictive control (MPC). Agent-based model predictive control (AMPC) has recently emerged as a distributed solution that treats controllers as agents, creating a collaborative framework among them to reach a common goal. However, this approach struggles to manage distributed conflicting objectives when agents are coupled or interdependent. To address this, we propose a novel, practical distributed control scheme called multi-objective AMPC, which adapts the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) into a general control strategy that approximates global optimization while decoupling objectives. We systematically develop three formulations that maintain convergence while addressing control regularization and inequality constraints, applying them to complex vehicle control systems for the first time. The proposed method has been tested on two vehicle control scenarios with a multi-objective topology. Different formulations are compared through simulations, and the most computationally efficient one was implemented on an electric vehicle for real-world evaluations. The results demonstrate that the proposed multi-objective AMPC can converge approximately to the same global optimum as integrated MPC with greater flexibility and the potential to reduce computational costs.
summary_zh: 功能集成是车辆控制领域的发展趋势，通常需要协调多个控制器同时实现多种控制目标。灵活性与可靠性需求推动控制领域向“即插即用”的设计思路发展，这对传统集成式模型预测控制（MPC）提出了挑战。基于智能体的模型预测控制（AMPC）作为分布式解决方案近期得到关注，该方案将各个控制器视为独立智能体，构建协同框架以实现共同目标。但该方法在智能体存在耦合或依赖关系时，难以有效管理分布式的冲突目标。针对该问题，本文提出一种实用的新型分布式控制方案——多目标AMPC，将交替方向乘子法（ADMM）改造为通用控制策略，在解耦目标的同时逼近全局优化结果。本文系统推导了三种可维持收敛性的公式化实现方案，同时兼顾控制正则化与不等式约束，首次将其应用于复杂车辆控制系统。所提方法已在两个具备多目标拓扑的车辆控制场景下完成测试，通过仿真对比了不同实现方案的性能，将计算效率最高的方案部署到实电动车上开展了真实场景测试。结果表明，所提多目标AMPC可收敛到与集成式MPC几乎一致的全局最优解，同时具备更高的灵活性，具备降低计算成本的潜力。

title: RodForesight: A World Model Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Slender and Material Agnostic Rod Insertion
title_zh: RodForesight：融合世界模型增强扩散策略的材质无关细长杆插入方法
authors: Chuanbo Yu, Mingyu Yue, Yan Lyu, Chuhan Song, Peng Wang
abstract: Slender rod insertion arises in precision manufacturing, where millimetre scale diameter and tight clearances demand accurate perception and control. Conventional peg-in-hole methods assume a rigid object whose tip pose is fixed relative to the gripper. This assumption breaks down for a high aspect ratio rod, which can bend during manipulation, making its tip motion dependent on the rod configuration, grasp, material properties, and contact. We present RodForesight, a learning framework that factorises the task into two stages: 1) coarse approaching, which uses visual servoing to map diverse initial configurations into a compact near hole hand-off region; and 2) predictive insertion, which performs fine alignment and completes the insertion. It is worth noting that the two stages can be wrapped into an end-to-end design. During insertion, a diffusion policy generates candidate action chunks, while an action conditioned world model predicts their effects on rod-hole alignment. This pre-execution evaluation enables RodForesight to select the best action chunk based on predicted tilt and radial errors before execution. Experiments investigate the performance of different stages and the end-to-end setting, where RodForesight improves the success rate from 88.9% to 96.7%, compared to baseline methods such as diffusion policy.
summary_zh: 细长杆插入是精密制造领域的典型任务，毫米级直径与极小配合间隙要求极高的感知与控制精度。传统的 peg-in-hole（孔中插销）方法假设对象为刚体，其末端位姿相对于夹爪固定。该假设在处理大长径比杆件时不再成立：这类杆件在操作过程中会发生弯曲，末端运动与杆件构型、抓取状态、材料属性和接触状态高度相关。本文提出RodForesight这一学习框架，将任务分解为两个阶段：1）粗接近阶段：采用视觉伺服将多样化的初始构型映射到紧凑的孔附近交接区域；2）预测插入阶段：完成精细对齐与插入操作。两个阶段可整合为端到端的设计。插入过程中，扩散策略生成候选动作块，而以动作为条件的世界模型可预测这些动作对杆孔对齐状态的影响。这种执行前评估机制让RodForesight可以在执行动作前，基于预测得到的倾斜误差与径向误差选择最优动作块。本文通过实验验证了不同阶段与端到端设置的性能，结果表明相比扩散策略等基线方法，RodForesight可将任务成功率从88.9%提升至96.7%。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Conflict Detection Against Operator-Conditioned Weather Hazards
title_zh: 面向操作员关联气象危害的不确定性感知冲突检测
authors: Balram Kandoria, Seulki Kim, Aryaman Singh Samyal
abstract: Strategic flight plan validation in Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) environments requires robust methods for predicting aircraft state uncertainty and detecting potential conflicts with dynamic airspace hazards. This paper presents a novel framework for uncertainty-conditioned trajectory prediction combined with polyhedra hazard representation for pre-flight conflict detection. We introduce a closed-form uncertainty estimation method that couples non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) curve fitting for kinematic trajectory generation with a Kalman Filter for state covariance propagation. Drawing from the Light Propagation Algorithm (LPA) paradigm, we employ a sigmoid-blended measurement noise model that captures the uncertainty reduction behavior of flight management systems approaching the required time of arrival (RTA) for waypoints. The resulting temporal uncertainty bounds are derived through a velocity-to-time variance transformation, enabling probabilistic assessment of arrival time deviations along the flight path. For hazard representation, we develop an operator-conditioned classification scheme that transforms gridded environmental data, specifically weather phenomena, into three-dimensional polyhedra volumes with intensity-based stratification. These hazard polyhedra incorporate aircraft-specific safety buffers computed from vehicle performance characteristics. Conflict detection is performed through mesh intersection algorithms operating on the spatial uncertainty tube surrounding the mean trajectory against the hazard polyhedra and temporal overlap. The framework enables the continuous strategic validation of flight plans throughout the pre-flight planning time horizon as environmental conditions evolve.
summary_zh: 先进空中交通（Advanced Air Mobility, AAM）环境下的战略飞行计划验证需要鲁棒的方法来预测航空器状态不确定性，检测与动态空域危害的潜在冲突。本文提出一种融合不确定性条件轨迹预测与多面体危害表示的新型框架，用于飞行前冲突检测。本文引入闭式不确定性估计方法，将用于运动轨迹生成的非均匀有理B样条（NURBS）曲线拟合与用于状态协方差传播的卡尔曼滤波器相结合，参考光传播算法（Light Propagation Algorithm, LPA）范式，采用sigmoid混合测量噪声模型，捕捉飞行管理系统接近航点所需到达时间（Required Time of Arrival, RTA）时的不确定性衰减特性。通过速度-时间方差变换推导得到时间不确定性边界，可对飞行路径上的到达时间偏差进行概率评估。针对危害表示，本文开发了操作员关联的分类方案，将网格化环境数据（尤其是气象现象）转换为按强度分层的三维多面体空间，这类危害多面体内还纳入了基于飞行器性能特性计算得到的航空器专属安全缓冲区。冲突检测通过网格相交算法实现，算法将平均轨迹周围的空间不确定性管与危害多面体进行空间相交判断，同时完成时间重叠校验。该框架可在飞行前规划全周期内，随着环境条件的动态演化，持续对飞行计划进行战略验证。

title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
title_zh: 面向机器人工厂的高效视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型管理与服务系统
authors: Dionysios Adamopoulos, Nattapol Chanpaisit, Basel Fakhri, Christina Giannoula
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models by sharing these streams across them, prioritizing requests by least remaining SLO time. Our management engine enables flexible model placements on multi-GPU servers, and integrates an intelligent traffic controller that maximizes per-model batching under the chosen placement while bounding each GPU's load to meet SLOs. For individual models, Robion serves on average 6.7$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ higher robot load within 98% SLO attainment over vLLM-Omni, the most widely used multi-stage serving system, and Monolithic, which runs VLM and ADiT as a single pipeline, respectively. In a large-scale experiment of serving 8 different models on a 4-GPU server, Robion can serve up to 64 robots within 98% SLO attainment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型通过两阶段设计展现出极强的机器人操作能力：第一阶段为视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM），第二阶段为动作扩散Transformer（Action Diffusion Transformer, ADiT）。由于机器人必须满足安全相关的严格服务水平目标（Service-Level Objectives, SLOs），VLA推理本质上属于延迟敏感型任务。要满足这些SLO要求需要高端GPU，但受重量、成本和功耗限制，机器人本体无法集成这类高性能GPU。现有研究将VLA推理卸载到边缘服务器，由边缘服务器为多台机器人提供VLA模型服务。但当前VLA系统无法在多GPU服务器上的SLO约束下支持多请求、多模型执行，而现有的面向多阶段模型的服务系统均针对吞吐量和跨独立GPU的阶段解耦做了优化，并不适配VLA模型毫秒级的单阶段运行特性。本文提出Robion，首个面向多GPU边缘服务器、支持多机器人多模型请求且满足SLO约束的VLA服务与管理系统。其服务引擎通过两个流在单GPU内对VLM和ADiT阶段进行解耦，动态限制VLM流占用的流式多处理器（SM）资源，确保ADiT始终可获得SM资源与VLM并行运行；同时通过跨模型共享流实现多模型共置部署，并基于剩余SLO时间最短的优先级对请求进行调度。其管理引擎支持多GPU服务器上的灵活模型部署，集成智能流量控制器，可在选定部署方案下最大化单模型批处理规模，同时限制单GPU负载以满足SLO要求。在单模型场景下，Robion的98% SLO达标率下可承载的机器人负载，分别是应用最广泛的多阶段服务系统vLLM-Omni、将VLM和ADiT作为单流水线运行的Monolithic方案的6.7倍和1.5倍。在4-GPU服务器上部署8种不同模型的大规模实验中，Robion可在98% SLO达标率下最多为64台机器人提供服务。

title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
title_zh: Pelican-Sim 1.0：面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器
authors: Shilong Zou, Shilin Zhang, Yingji Zhang, Yuhang Huang, Yi Zhang 等 (11 人)
abstract: In this technical report, we propose Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions to support downstream learning and decision making. The model incorporates four key design features: (1) Unified action representation: a 28-dimensional action value space covering most mainstream embodiments, keeping one model valid across heterogeneous devices. (2) Action-visual injection: URDF- and camera-rendered action videos bridge actions and pixels, giving markedly better controllability across embodiments, scenes, and tasks (PSNR +0.904 over alternative fusion baselines). (3) Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE): sparse MoE layers add capacity for heterogeneous dynamics and absorb the action modality while reducing inter-modality conflict (FVD -6.530 vs. the dense backbone). (4) Efficient rollout generation: causal adaptation and few-step distillation yield a four-step autoregressive simulator, achieving a 5.67-fold speedup over the 35-step model. Benefiting from these designs, we train on approximately one million real-world and simulated trajectories and obtain large gains in action controllability and video quality: PSNR improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by 4.636 on AgiBotWorld Beta, 2.080 on RoboMIND, and 10.343 on RoboTwin, with the adapted EWMBench DYN score up 0.426 on RoboTwin. Relying on this, four downstream applications on RoboTwin succeed: 500 generated trajectories added to 50 demonstrations per task raise policy success from 70% to 93%; policy evaluation reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.994 across five checkpoints; and relative success gains reach 47.7% for action selection and 20.3% for policy improvement. Qualitative generalization across trajectory, scene, object, embodiment, and viewpoint shifts highlights its potential as a general-purpose world model simulator.
summary_zh: 本技术报告提出Pelican-Sim 1.0，一款面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器，可基于视觉上下文和机器人动作预测未来观测结果，为下游学习和决策提供支撑。该模型包含四项核心设计特性：（1）统一动作表示：采用覆盖绝大多数主流具身形态的28维动作值空间，使单模型可在异构设备上通用；（2）动作-视觉注入：基于统一机器人描述格式（URDF）和相机渲染生成动作视频，打通动作与像素的关联，在跨具身形态、场景和任务场景下的可控性显著提升，相比其他融合基线方案峰值信噪比（PSNR）提升0.904；（3）稀疏混合专家模型（Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）：稀疏MoE层提升了异构动力学建模能力，可吸收动作模态特征同时减少模态间冲突，相比密集骨干网络的弗雷歇视频距离（FVD）降低6.530；（4）高效推演生成：通过因果适配和少步蒸馏得到四步自回归模拟器，相比35步模型实现5.67倍的速度提升。依托上述设计，我们在约100万条真实世界和模拟轨迹上完成训练，在动作可控性和视频质量上获得大幅提升：在AgiBotWorld Beta、RoboMIND、RoboTwin数据集上，相比最优评估基线的PSNR分别提升4.636、2.080和10.343，在RoboTwin上适配后的EWMBench DYN得分提升0.426。基于该模拟器，RoboTwin上的四类下游应用均取得成功：为每个任务的50条演示轨迹补充500条生成轨迹后，策略成功率从70%提升至93%；策略评估在5个检查点上的皮尔逊相关系数达到0.994；动作选择的相对收益提升47.7%，策略优化的相对收益提升20.3%。在轨迹、场景、物体、具身形态和视角偏移场景下的泛化性定性结果，证明该模拟器具备作为通用世界模型模拟器的应用潜力。

title: Rethinking Heterogeneous System Disaggregation for Subquadratic Attention
title_zh: 面向次二次注意力的异构系统解耦设计反思
authors: Arya Tschand, Yaosheng Fu, Vikram Sharma Mailthody, Nicolai Oswald, Po-An Tsai 等 (9 人)
abstract: Frontier language models are more aggressively using subquadratic attention to reduce the memory footprint and compute requirements during inference while still delivering frontier accuracy. While existing systems make dense attention-centric disaggregated serving decisions, we show that disaggregating inference around the unique arithmetic intensity and memory footprint of subquadratic attention LLMs can achieve significant throughput and energy efficiency gains on emerging DRAM-based and SRAM-only heterogeneous systems.We introduce SQD (SubQuadratic Disaggregation), a fine-grained heterogeneous disaggregation scheme that splits decode by quadratic and subquadratic attention rather than by operator type, and that applies across subquadratic attention variants. For sparse attention LLMs, we disaggregate decode into top-k selection, which must index through the full KV, and top-k attention plus FFN, which have static memory footprints. For linear and sliding-window attention LLMs, we disaggregate decode into dense attention layers and subquadratic attention layers plus FFN. In an adjusted 8xB200 heterogeneous system proxy, we observe average tokens/J improvements of 53% on GLM 5.2, 31% on Nemotron 3 Ultra, and 56% on Gemma 4 31B over the strongest GPU-only baselines. In an analytical model of a Rubin plus LPX system with fixed power budgets, we observe 1.2x to 1.5x tighter achievable latencies and up to 3.6x higher throughput over the best baseline of attention-FFN disaggregation. Our experiments also reveal architectural insights on chip and interconnect provisioning for next-generation heterogeneous systems serving subquadratic attention.
summary_zh: 前沿语言模型正越来越多地采用次二次注意力，在保持顶尖精度的同时降低推理过程的内存占用和计算需求。现有系统均围绕密集注意力做中心化的解耦服务决策，本文研究表明，围绕次二次注意力大语言模型（LLM）独特的运算强度和内存占用特性对推理进行解耦，可在新兴的基于DRAM和仅SRAM的异构系统上实现显著的吞吐量和能效提升。本文提出SQD（SubQuadratic Disaggregation，次二次解耦），一种细粒度异构解耦方案，不再按算子类型拆分解码过程，而是按二次注意力和次二次注意力拆分解码流程，可适配所有次二次注意力变体。针对稀疏注意力LLM，我们将解码过程拆分为需要遍历全部键值缓存（KV）的Top-K选择阶段，以及内存占用固定的Top-K注意力+前馈网络（FFN）阶段。针对线性注意力和滑动窗口注意力LLM，我们将解码过程拆分为密集注意力层、次二次注意力层+FFN两个部分。在调整后的8×B200异构系统代理测试中，相比最优的仅GPU基线方案，GLM 5.2、Nemotron 3 Ultra、Gemma 4 31B的平均每焦耳生成token数分别提升53%、31%和56%。在固定功耗预算的Rubin+LPX系统分析模型中，相比注意力-FFN解耦的最优基线，可实现1.2~1.5倍的更低延迟，吞吐量最高提升3.6倍。本文实验还为面向次二次注意力服务的下一代异构系统的芯片和互连资源配置提供了架构层面的洞见。

title: A Hybrid LSTM-XGBoost Framework for Multi-Horizon Stock Return Prediction Across Diversified Equity Portfolios
title_zh: 面向多元股票组合多周期收益预测的LSTM-XGBoost混合框架
authors: Seif ElDein Mostafa, Yahia Ahmed, Farah Datwish, Marwa Solayman
abstract: Accurate prediction of equity returns remains a major challenge in computational finance due to the non-stationary, nonlinear, and low signal-to-noise ratio nature of financial time series. This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage architecture that combines a long short-term memory (LSTM) network with an XGBoost gradient-boosted regressor for multi-horizon stock return prediction across a diversified panel of 14 U.S. equities spanning six industry sectors. The LSTM component, comprising two stacked layers with 64 hidden units, processes 60-day sliding windows of five sequential market features to produce 64-dimensional temporal embeddings that encode learned sequential market dynamics. These embeddings are concatenated with 14 hand-crafted technical indicators to form a 78-dimensional hybrid feature vector, which is subsequently passed to an XGBoost regressor tuned via 3-fold cross-validation grid search. The framework is trained on a multi-stock pooled corpus using strict chronological splits and per-stock MinMaxScaling to prevent look-ahead bias, and evaluated across four prediction horizons of 30, 90, 252, and 365 trading days. Experimental results demonstrate that the hybrid model achieves a test RMSE of 0.0949 on the 30-day horizon, roughly one-third that of the standalone LSTM baseline, while marginally matching or surpassing the XGBoost-Only baseline across the majority of stocks. Directional accuracy rises with horizon length, reaching 97.6% at 365 days; we show, however, that this largely tracks the high base rate of positive long-horizon returns in the sample, and we therefore benchmark directional accuracy against a naive always-positive predictor and treat the above-base-rate gap at short horizons as the more informative signal. A composite investment scoring framework derived from multi-horizon predictions is further proposed to support portfolio ranking and decision support.
summary_zh: 由于金融时间序列的非平稳、非线性、低信噪比特性，精准预测股票收益始终是计算金融领域的核心挑战。本文提出一种两阶段混合架构，结合长短期记忆网络（Long Short-Term Memory, LSTM）和XGBoost梯度提升回归器，对覆盖6个行业板块的14只美国股票构成的多元面板数据开展多周期股票收益预测。该框架的LSTM组件包含2个堆叠层，共64个隐藏单元，以5类连续市场特征的60天滑动窗口作为输入，生成编码了学习到的连续市场动态的64维时序嵌入。该嵌入与14个人工构造的技术指标拼接，形成78维混合特征向量，输入经3折交叉验证网格搜索调优的XGBoost回归器。该框架采用严格的时序拆分和单股票MinMax归一化在多股票合并数据集上训练，避免前瞻偏差，并在30、90、252、365个交易日共4个预测周期上完成评估。实验结果表明，该混合模型在30天周期上的测试集均方根误差（RMSE）为0.0949，约为纯LSTM基线的1/3，且在绝大多数股票上的表现与纯XGBoost基线持平甚至更优。方向准确率随预测周期长度上升，在365天周期上达到97.6%；但研究表明该结果很大程度上与样本中长周期收益普遍为正的高基准率相关，因此本文将方向准确率与始终预测为正的朴素预测器做对比，将短周期下超出基准率的差值作为更有价值的信号。本文进一步提出基于多周期预测的综合投资评分框架，为股票组合排序和决策提供支撑。

title: CMA-OT: Hierarchical Expert Supervision for Dance-to-Music Generation
authors: Jinting Wang, Chenxing Li, Dong Yu, Li Liu
abstract: Dance-to-music (D2M) generation aims to synthesize music that is rhythmically and stylistically aligned with dance videos. A key challenge arises from the semantic mismatch between sparse dance cues, such as rhythm and style, and the dense information required for music composition, including structure, instrumentation, and expressive dynamics. Existing methods typically rely on these sparse cues and supervise only the final audio output, resulting in poorly learned music representations and generated music with limited musicality and structural coherence. To address these issues, we propose Curriculum-guided Multi-scale representation Alignment with scale-aware Optimal Transport (CMA-OT), a novel paradigm that leverages an external music expert to provide hierarchical supervision for the generator's latent features, bridging the semantic gap and enhancing representation learning. To effectively incorporate hierarchical supervision, we introduce a curriculum-guided multi-scale learning strategy that progressively transfers musical knowledge from the expert to the music generator, enabling stable and effective representation learning. Moreover, to accommodate the semantic and structural variations across different expert scales and achieve fine-grained alignment under temporal mismatch, we propose a scale-aware optimal transport alignment mechanism, which models soft correspondences between hierarchical expert representations and the generator's latent features. Extensive experiments on two datasets demonstrate that CMA-OT achieves state-of-the-art performance in rhythmic synchronization, perceptual quality, and overall music generation.

title: Embodied-BenchForge: A Closed-Loop Agentic Workflow for Embodied Benchmark Construction
title_zh: Embodied-BenchForge：面向具身基准构建的闭环智能体工作流
authors: Baoyang Jiang, Fengchun Zhang, Leyuan Wang, Haotian Li, Yida Wang 等 (12 人)
abstract: Agentic systems offer a promising way to automate embodied benchmark construction, but existing approaches typically cover isolated stages or remain specialized to predefined environments and task families. More importantly, multi-step construction produces dependent intermediate artifacts that are often passed downstream without artifact-specific verification, allowing local defects to propagate into the final benchmark. We present Embodied-BenchForge, an agentic framework that transforms user-specified evaluation intents into complete embodied benchmark artifacts. It formulates construction as Closed-Loop Benchmark Synthesis, integrating forward artifact synthesis with backward verification and repair. Skill-Orchestrated Artifact Synthesis composes typed and reusable skills into executable workflows, while an artifact dependency graph records intermediate outputs and their dependencies. Requirement-Guided Verification and Repair applies artifact-specific contracts throughout construction and uses provenance to trigger local re-execution or upstream rollback when verification fails. Embodied-BenchForge constructs six benchmarks covering diverse embodied scenarios in the Offline EQA Track, together with one interactive benchmark containing 220 executable tasks in the Interactive Embodied Track. Evaluations of representative MLLMs and embodied agents show that the benchmarks distinguish model capabilities in both observation-based understanding and closed-loop execution. Quality assessment and ablations validate benchmark quality and the effectiveness of verification and repair, while repair and skill-reuse analyses demonstrate efficient localized recovery and cross-benchmark reusability.
summary_zh: 智能体系统为自动化构建具身基准提供了可行路径，但现有方案通常仅覆盖孤立阶段，或仅适配预定义环境和任务族。更重要的是，多步构建过程生成的依赖中间产物通常直接传递到下游，未针对产物本身做校验，导致局部缺陷会传播到最终基准中。本文提出Embodied-BenchForge，一款智能体框架，可将用户指定的评估意图转化为完整的具身基准产物。该框架将基准构建定义为闭环基准合成流程，融合前向产物合成与反向校验修复两个环节：其中技能编排式产物合成将类型化、可复用的技能组合为可执行工作流，同时通过产物依赖图记录中间输出及其依赖关系；需求引导式校验修复在整个构建过程中应用针对不同产物的约束规则，在校验失败时基于溯源信息触发局部重执行或上游回滚。Embodied-BenchForge共构建了覆盖离线EQA赛道不同具身场景的6个基准，以及包含220个可执行任务的交互式具身赛道基准。对代表性多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和具身智能体的评估结果表明，这些基准可有效区分模型在基于观测的理解能力和闭环执行能力上的差异。质量评估和消融实验验证了基准的质量以及校验修复机制的有效性，修复效率和技能复用性分析结果证明该框架可实现高效的局部故障恢复，且跨基准的技能复用性表现优异。

title: MP-Bench: Evaluating Voice Agents as a Multiparty Conversation Participant
title_zh: MP-Bench：评估语音智能体作为多方对话参与者的能力
authors: Yi-Jen Shih, Shih-Yun Shan Kuan, Guan-Ting Lin, Kai-Wei Chang, Siddhant Arora 等 (10 人)
abstract: Conversational voice agents have advanced significantly, offering increasingly natural human-machine interactions through both cascaded and end-to-end architectures. However, while recent benchmarks extensively evaluate dyadic interactions and passive audio comprehension, they largely overlook a prevalent real-world scenario: multi-party conversations. Evaluating agents in these settings is fundamentally more challenging than in dyadic interactions due to the exponentially greater conversational complexity. For voice agents to integrate seamlessly into human group dynamics, they must not only generate contextually appropriate responses but also demonstrate a nuanced understanding of open turn-taking. To address this gap, we introduce Multiparty Bench (MP-Bench), the first benchmark specifically designed to objectively evaluate conversational speech systems as active participants within multi-party contexts. MP-Bench assesses agent behavior along two primary dimensions: turn-taking awareness and response appropriateness. Additionally, we incorporate comprehension-based question-answering tasks as a complementary evaluation. By benchmarking 12 voice agents, we find that real-time voice agents stay at or below 22% on multiparty comprehension and remain near chance on multiparty turn-taking, exposing an open challenge for real-time voice agents under multiparty scenario.
summary_zh: 对话式语音智能体技术已取得显著进展，通过级联架构和端到端架构均可实现越来越自然的人机交互。但现有基准大多仅针对二元交互场景和被动音频理解能力做评估，普遍忽略了现实世界中广泛存在的多方对话场景。由于对话复杂度呈指数级上升，在该场景下评估智能体的难度远高于二元交互场景。若要让语音智能体无缝融入人类群体交互，不仅需要生成符合上下文的回复，还需要对开放式话轮切换机制形成精细理解。为填补这一空白，本文提出MP-Bench（Multiparty Bench），首个专门用于客观评估对话语音系统作为多方对话场景主动参与者能力的基准。MP-Bench从两个核心维度评估智能体行为：话轮切换意识和回复恰当性，同时引入基于理解的问答任务作为补充评估。通过对12款语音智能体的基准测试，我们发现实时语音智能体的多方对话理解准确率最高仅为22%，多方话轮切换能力接近随机水平，暴露出实时语音智能体在多方场景下的核心待解决挑战。

title: Autonomous Research for Open-Ended Problems: A Case Study on Telecom Ticket Retrieval
title_zh: 面向开放域问题的自主研究：以电信工单检索为案例研究
authors: Junghyun Min, Huseyin Uzunalioglu, Mohamed Trabelsi
abstract: Recent breakthroughs in LLM-based systems and their abilities in problem solving and coding have allowed progress in the AI for Science paradigm, potentially replacing human roles in machine learning (ML) research. However, while several frameworks of fully autonomous end-to-end ML research have been proposed, successful implementations of them are often limited to problems with narrow search spaces, like language modeling or biomedical ML benchmarks. In this paper, we explore how autonomous research can be adapted to solve open-ended, industry-grade ML problems, by considering a case study: telecom ticket retrieval, an open-ended task with degrees of freedom in representation, architecture, and training data generation. We discover that autonomous research for open-ended problems with commercial and open-source agents shows both promise and limitations: while autonomous research can excel in narrow hyperparameter optimization, it lacks human-like intuition and creativity and requires operational overhead. Even with minimal human supervision, autonomous research can reach $90\%$ of state-of-the-art performance (0.34 vs. 0.38 Recall@1) in a much shorter time period (10 weeks vs. 10 months of human work) at a modest cost (up to \$200 per Cursor campaign). Our empirical evidence recommends that human researchers and autonomous research frameworks work together for best results in ML research.
summary_zh: 近期大语言模型（LLM）系统在问题求解和代码生成能力上的突破推动了AI for Science范式的发展，使其有望替代人类完成机器学习（ML）研究工作。但目前已提出的多款完全自主端到端ML研究框架，其成功落地案例大多局限于搜索空间较窄的问题，例如语言建模或生物医学ML基准。本文以电信工单检索这一开放域任务为案例，探索如何将自主研究方案适配到开放域、工业级ML问题中，该任务在表示方法、架构设计和训练数据生成层面均存在大量可调整自由度。研究发现，基于商用和开源智能体的开放域问题自主研究方案同时具备优势和局限性：自主研究在窄空间超参数优化任务上表现优异，但缺乏类人的直觉和创造力，且存在一定的运行开销。即使仅需极少量人工监督，自主研究也可在远短于人工研究的时间内（10周对比10个月）以较低成本（单次Cursor campaign最高花费200美元）达到当前最优性能的90%（Top1召回率0.34对比0.38）。本文的实证结果表明，人类研究者与自主研究框架协同工作可在ML研究中取得最优效果。

title: MAxBench: A Multinomial Concept Recovery Benchmark
title_zh: MAxBench：多项概念恢复基准
authors: Divya Appapogu, Freya Behrens, Yonatan Belinkov, Aaron Mueller
abstract: Fine-grained control of language model behaviors (e.g., steering) is among the more actionable outcomes of interpretability research. For binary concepts such as refusal, a single direction in activation space often suffices for steering. However, many concepts are not binary: Animals and Countries contain many subcategories, each with multiple instances. For these concepts, the search space over possible representation geometries is far larger than for binary concepts; it is thus not clear what geometries are most appropriate, nor what methods are most effective at recovering them. In this work, we introduce MAxBench, a geometry-agnostic evaluation framework for multinomial concept representations based on sampling from the recovered concept representation. We use MAxBench to compare 10 localization methods (covering 5 geometry types) across 6 concepts and 4 models. Using this framework, we find that (i) affine subspaces steer more reliably and have greater recall than rank-one or linear subspaces; (ii) much of this advantage is due to better non-zero offsets rather than the choice of bases; (iii) manifold steering is competitive with the best methods when applicable; and (iv) no method consistently outperforms prompting, in alignment with prior findings on binary concepts. These findings underscore the importance of expanding the scope of interpretability research and meta-evaluation to concepts with more varied structure.
summary_zh: 对语言模型行为的细粒度控制（例如引导干预）是可解释性研究中具备较高落地价值的方向之一。对于拒绝回答这类二元概念，激活空间中的单个方向即可实现引导。但大量概念并非二元：动物、国家这类概念包含大量子类别，每个子类别下又包含多个实例。针对这类概念，其可能的表示几何结构的搜索空间远大于二元概念，目前学界尚不清楚哪种几何结构最适配这类概念，也不清楚哪种方法恢复这类概念的效果最优。本文提出MAxBench（Multinomial Concept Recovery Benchmark），一种与几何结构无关的多项概念表示评估框架，基于从恢复得到的概念表示中采样的方式完成评估。我们使用MAxBench在6个概念、4个模型上对比了覆盖5类几何结构的10种定位方法，得到如下结论：（1）仿射子空间的引导可靠性和召回率均高于秩1子空间或线性子空间；（2）该优势主要来自于更优的非零偏移量，而非基向量的选择；（3）流形引导在适用场景下的表现可与最优方法持平；（4）没有任何方法的表现能稳定优于提示工程，这与此前二元概念相关研究的结论一致。上述发现表明，可解释性研究和元评估需要进一步拓展研究范围，覆盖具备更多样结构的概念。

title: Involving before Evolving: A Vision for Trustworthy Enterprise Digital Twin Engineering
title_zh: 演进前先参与：可信企业数字孪生工程愿景
authors: Kérian Fiter, Adil Lagrou, Franck Dervault, Bentley Oakes
abstract: Enterprise Digital Twins (EDTs) promise data-driven decision support at organizational scale, but realizing them requires navigating siloed departments, tacit knowledge, and high-stakes decisions with long-horizon consequences. Existing approaches involve domain experts during model development but focus less on early organizational buy-in in EDTs. We present a vision for trustworthy EDT engineering grounded in an `involving before evolving' paradigm: rapidly involving stakeholders through a working prototype before evolving toward federation and full interoperability. Our three-stage approach combines foundation models for rapid prototyping, an ontological backbone for federated interoperability, and observability tooling for stakeholder trust. We ground our vision in an ongoing collaboration with Michelin, a multinational manufacturer, where an initial prototype has helped support stakeholder buy-in.
summary_zh: 企业数字孪生（Enterprise Digital Twin, EDT）可在组织层面提供数据驱动的决策支撑，但落地过程需要打通部门壁垒、处理隐性知识、支撑影响周期长的高风险决策。现有方案大多在模型开发阶段引入领域专家，但对EDT落地早期的组织共识构建关注不足。本文提出基于「演进前先参与」范式的可信EDT工程愿景：在向联邦化和完全互操作状态演进之前，先通过可运行原型快速让所有利益相关方参与进来。该三阶段方案结合了用于快速原型开发的基础模型、用于联邦互操作的本体主干、以及用于构建利益相关方信任的可观测性工具。本文基于与跨国制造商米其林的持续合作验证该愿景，目前已开发的初始原型已成功支撑利益相关方达成共识。

title: Anchoring Clinical Events in Time: UID-Preserving Multimodal Reconstruction and Source-Grounded Adjudication
title_zh: 临床事件时间锚定：保留唯一标识符（UID）的多模态重构与基于源数据的裁决
authors: Sayantan Kumar, Nicolas Grimaldi, Jack Cummins, Jeremy C. Weiss
abstract: Clinical timelines support treatment-window analysis and leakage-free modeling, but discharge summaries often obscure chronology and structured EHR tables describe only part of the patient course. We present a UID-preserving framework that links each narrative event occurrence to its source span and retains that identity through text-only estimation, structured-evidence retrieval, timestamped source-row grounding, and joint revision. We also present GAVEL, an LLM judge that compares two UID-aligned timelines against the narrative and structured record, to augment prior matching and temporal assessments. Across six open-weight models and 40 mixed-critical-care summaries, the GLM 5.2 multimodal revision, as compared to its text-only variant, improved temporal agreement without reducing event recovery and performed competitively with clinician annotations, while other model revisions showed smaller gains and lower overall performance. Ablations showed that UIDs primarily preserve event retention, whereas source-row linkage supports temporal placement. Blinded human review upheld most GAVEL findings, and controlled adjudication favored multimodal over text-only GLM 5.2 but did not for DeepSeek V3.2. In developing the UID and judge pipeline, we are able to demonstrate 43\% increased event recovery, a framework competitive with clinician annotations, and a system with occurrence-level provenance for both reconstruction and evaluation.
summary_zh: 临床时间线可支持治疗窗口分析与无数据泄露建模，但出院小结通常会模糊时间先后顺序，而结构化电子病历（EHR）表仅能描述患者病程的部分内容。本文提出一种保留UID的框架，可将每个叙事事件实例关联到其原始文本跨度，并在纯文本估计、结构化证据检索、带时间戳源行锚定与联合修正的全流程中保留该事件的唯一标识。本文还提出GAVEL，这是一种大语言模型（LLM）裁判，可对照叙事文本与结构化记录对比两条UID对齐的时间线，对现有匹配方法与时间评估体系形成补充。在6款开源权重模型与40份混合重症监护小结上开展的实验表明，GLM 5.2多模态修正版本相比其纯文本变体，在未降低事件召回率的前提下提升了时间一致性，表现可与临床医师标注结果相竞争；其余模型的修正版本提升幅度更小，整体性能更低。消融实验显示，UID主要用于保障事件留存率，而源行关联则支撑时间定位。盲法人工审核验证了GAVEL的多数判定结果，对照实验显示多模态版本GLM 5.2的裁决效果优于纯文本版本，但该结论不适用于DeepSeek V3.2。通过开发UID与裁判流水线，本研究实现了事件召回率提升43%，得到了性能可与临床医师标注相竞争的框架，以及在重构与评估全流程都具备实例级溯源能力的系统。

title: Diffusion Models and Concept Formation
title_zh: 扩散模型与概念形成
authors: Zekun Wang, Karthik Singaravadivelan, Christopher J. MacLellan
abstract: Humans organize knowledge into a taxonomy of concepts with nested levels of abstraction and a \emph{basic level} at which people recognize and name objects with the least cognitive effort. Cobweb is a classic cognitive account of this ability, an incremental learner that builds a probabilistic concept hierarchy by maximizing category utility. We argue that diffusion models, although designed for image synthesis, implicitly perform the same computation. The noisy marginals of a diffusion model are Gaussian smoothings of the data distribution, and the modes of these marginals form a hierarchy that corresponds to a Cobweb tree of probabilistic prototypes in four respects. Both are hierarchical density models, both are hierarchical-Bayesian models with Gaussian prototypes, both treat categorization as score-following that reduces uncertainty, and in both a basic level emerges. We locate this basic level for a diffusion model at an intermediate noise level, where recent analyses show that the reverse process commits to the class identity of a sample. The two models differ mainly in how they represent and learn the taxonomy. Cobweb learns a discrete tree incrementally, whereas a diffusion model encodes a continuous, interpolable hierarchy in a single learned score field fit to the data distribution. We test the correspondence on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST by recovering the diffusion hierarchy through mode-finding and comparing the basic levels of the two models. This reframes diffusion as a cognitive model of concept formation and offers Cobweb a continuous, scalable instantiation.
